def grids_from_demo_message(text):
 lines_=text.splitlines(); pairs=[]
 for i,line in enumerate(lines_):
  m=re.match(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):$',line)
  if not m: continue
  n,h,w=map(int,m.groups()); inp=[[int(x) for x in s.split()] for s in lines_[i+1:i+1+h]]
  outline=f'Demo pair {n} output ({h}x{w}):'
  j=i+1+h
  assert lines_[j]==outline, (lines_[j],outline)
  outgrid=[[int(x) for x in s.split()] for s in lines_[j+1:j+1+h]]
  pairs.append((inp,outgrid))
 return pairs
pairs=[pair for txt in texts for pair in grids_from_demo_message(txt)]
